description: NaIO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-68°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.42 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.82 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.80 Å. I is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms.
